name: Sadler Road Improvements
description: A 1.9-mile section of Sadler Road between Dominion Boulevard and Cedar Forest Road is being widened and realigned. The county's project page states that a shared-use path for pedestrians and bicyclists will be built on the east side of the new roadway, and that roundabouts are proposed at Innslake Drive and at Sadler Grove Road. The March and April 2024 issues printed the project as "Sadler Road Realignment and Improvements."
statusNote: Listed under "Starting Soon" from March 2024, moved to "New Construction this Month" in August 2024, and carried under "Currently in Construction" in September 2024.

name: Anoka Road & Fordson Road Traffic Circle
description: A traffic circle at Anoka Road and Fordson Road. The June 2024 issue adds that speed cushions will be placed on surrounding streets. The county's traffic-calming page for this project describes a roundabout at the intersection of Fordson Road and Anoka Road/Bronwood Road, with speed cushions on Anoka, Bronwood, Fordson and Alvarado roads.
statusNote: Listed under "Starting Soon" in March and April 2024, under "New Construction This Month" in June 2024, and reported "Construction completed!" in the July 2024 issue.

name: Twin Hickory Lake Drive at Hickory Bend Drive Intersection Improvements
description: A temporary roundabout at the Twin Hickory Lake Drive and Hickory Bend Drive intersection. The June 2024 issue states it is intended to improve safety and mobility; the county's project page describes it as following community input.
statusNote: First listed under "New Construction This Month" in June 2024; the July 2024 issue reported "Construction completed!"

name: Three Chopt Road & Cedarfield Parkway Traffic Signal
description: A traffic signal at Three Chopt Road and Cedarfield Parkway. The newsletters give no further detail, and no county project page is linked for it.
statusNote: Listed under "Starting Soon" in March and April 2024, then under "New Construction This Month" (June) and "Currently in Construction" (July). The printed note stayed "Construction starting in early summer" throughout, and the project does not appear in the August or September 2024 issues, so no completion was ever stated. Location not mapped — see the note on this page.

name: Traffic Signal Improvements and Upgrades
description: Signal improvements, upgrades and rebuilds at numerous locations. The county's ATMS Phase II project page describes the work as upgrading signal equipment across the county and lists it in all five magisterial districts, so it is recorded here without a single mapped location.
statusNote: Carried under "Currently in Construction" in every issue from March to September 2024. The printed completion estimate moved from June 2024 (March and April issues) to end of 2024 (June issue onward). Location not mapped — this is a countywide program, not a single site.

name: Forest Avenue and Skipwith Road Intersection Improvements
description: Pedestrian improvements at the Forest Avenue and Skipwith Road intersection. The county's project page describes new ADA ramps and a signal for pedestrians to cross, with the existing span wire supporting the signal heads removed and a mast arm built in its place.
statusNote: Listed under "Starting Soon" in the September 2024 issue, with construction scheduled to begin by the end of the year.

name: Parham and Mayland Roads Intersection Improvements
description: Intersection improvements at Parham and Mayland roads. The county's project page for this location, titled "Span Wires and Pedestrian Accommodations," describes replacing the span wires at the Parham/Mayland intersection and upgrading the signal equipment.
statusNote: Listed under "Starting Soon" in the September 2024 issue, with construction scheduled to begin by the end of the year.
